title: High-Throughput Echo Library Prep Protocol
author: Madeline Y Mayday
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.tcaeise
materials: Load reagents into Echo source plates by pipetting reagents into each required well and seal with a foil seal. Pipet carefully to avoid formation of bubbles. (Echo Qualified 384-Well Polypropylene , PP-0200, https://www.labcyte.com/products/consumables/echo-qualified-source-plates) (Labcyte Echo Qualified Reservoir, ER-0050, https://www.labcyte.com/products/consumables/echo-qualified-reservoir) For reagent master mixes that require more than 12 source wells of a 384-well Echo source plate (PP-200), it may be prudent to use a 6-well reservoir source plate (ER-0050) to minimize dead volume. For example, in this prep, samples require a large volume of second strand synthesis master mix. Using a 6-well Echo reservoir plate for this step reduces dead volume and therefore requires less of the reagent in the master mix.

steps.title: Dry RNA samples
steps.instruction: Place the RNA plate in a Genevac EZ‑2 vacuum evaporator and dry at ~40 °C for 25–30 min (time varies with sample number and machine) until completely dry.

steps.title: Load RNA into plate
steps.instruction: Pipette 5 µL of each RNA sample into a 384‑well PCR plate, record the well location, and arrange the plate into four 96‑sample quadrants to enable multichannel dispensing.

steps.title: Prepare master mixes
steps.instruction: Prepare fragmentation, first‑strand, and second‑strand master mixes (NEBNext Ultra II RNA Library Prep Kit, Cat #E7770S/L) in volumes that account for dead volume and the 20–65 µL working range of a 384‑well Echo‑qualified source plate.

steps.title: Centrifuge source plates
steps.instruction: Spin each Echo source plate containing master mixes for 5 min at 400 g to remove bubbles; ensure reagents are at room temperature before Echo dispensing.

steps.title: Survey source plate volumes
steps.instruction: Use the Echo 525 “Survey” setting to verify that every source well contains between 20 µL and 65 µL of liquid.

steps.title: Dispense fragmentation mix
steps.instruction: Load the source plate into the Echo 525, select the BP setting, and dispense 1000 nL of fragmentation master mix into each sample well; confirm no bubbles remain.

steps.title: Seal, vortex, spin
steps.instruction: Remove the plate from the Echo, seal with a foil seal, gently vortex to mix, then perform a quick spin.

steps.title: Dispense first strand mix
steps.instruction: After removing the foil seal and re‑loading the plate into the Echo, use the BP setting to dispense 1000 nL of first‑strand synthesis master mix into each well.

steps.title: Seal, vortex, spin
steps.instruction: Seal the plate with foil, vortex gently, and quick‑spin.

steps.title: First strand incubation
steps.instruction: Place the plate in a thermocycler with heated lid at 105 °C and run the following program: 25 °C – 10 min, 42 °C – 15 min, 70 °C – 15 min, then hold at 54 °C.

steps.title: Dispense second strand mix
steps.instruction: After thermocycling, remove the foil seal, reload the plate into the Echo and use the GP setting to dispense 6000 nL of second‑strand synthesis master mix into each well.

steps.title: Seal, vortex, spin
steps.instruction: Seal with foil, vortex gently, and quick‑spin.

steps.title: Bead clean (first)
steps.instruction: Perform a 1.4× Ampure bead clean on the Biomek NXP, eluting the sample with nuclease‑free water.

substeps.instruction: Add Ampure beads at 1.4× sample volume
Wash and elute with nuclease‑free water

steps.title: Prepare end‑prep & ligation mixes
steps.instruction: Prepare end‑prep, adaptor‑ligation, USER/PCR master mixes, and adaptor dilutions (NEBNext Adaptor for Illumina, Cat #E7337AA; NEB USER® Enzyme, Cat #M5505S/L) in volumes that keep each source well between 20 µL and 65 µL.

steps.title: Centrifuge new source plates
steps.instruction: Spin the new Echo source plate for 5 min at 400 g to eliminate bubbles; bring reagents to room temperature.

steps.title: Survey new source volumes
steps.instruction: Run the Echo “Survey” to confirm each well contains 20–65 µL of the newly prepared mixes.

steps.title: Dispense end‑prep mix
steps.instruction: Using the BP setting on the Echo 525, dispense 1000 nL of end‑prep master mix into each sample well; verify no bubbles remain.

steps.title: Seal, vortex, spin
steps.instruction: Seal with foil, vortex gently, and quick‑spin.

steps.title: Dispense adaptor ligation mix & adaptor
steps.instruction: Load the plate into the Echo, use the GP setting to transfer 3100 nL of adaptor‑ligation master mix and then 250 nL of the appropriately diluted adaptor to each well (add separately to avoid adaptor dimers).

substeps.instruction: Remove foil seal and load plate

steps.title: Seal, vortex, spin
steps.instruction: Seal with foil, vortex gently, and quick‑spin.

steps.title: Prepare USER/PCR destination plate
steps.instruction: Set up a USER/PCR master‑mix plate that will serve as the final destination for cDNA after the post‑ligation bead clean; this must be ready before the bead clean step.

steps.title: Bead clean post‑ligation
steps.instruction: On the Biomek NXP, clean the end‑prepped, adaptor‑ligated cDNA with a 0.8× Ampure bead ratio; elute into the USER/PCR master‑mix plate using 5 µM TruSeq barcodes (≥10 µL barcode per well).

substeps.instruction: Load sample plate and USER/PCR plate onto Biomek
Add Ampure beads at 0.8× sample volume
Elute with 5 µM TruSeq barcodes (≥10 µL per well)

steps.title: Seal, vortex, spin
steps.instruction: Seal the plate with foil, vortex gently, and quick‑spin.

steps.title: PCR amplification cycles
steps.instruction: Perform PCR; choose the number of cycles based on the original RNA input, using a maximum of 19 cycles for samples with undetectable RNA.

steps.title: Bead clean post‑PCR
steps.instruction: Clean the post‑USER/PCR cDNA on the Biomek NXP with a 0.8× Ampure bead ratio, eluting in 25 µL nuclease‑free water and recovering 24 µL to account for Echo dead volume.

substeps.instruction: Add Ampure beads at 0.8× sample volume

steps.title: Optional second bead clean
steps.instruction: If QC shows significant primer‑ or adaptor‑dimers, perform a second 0.8× Ampure bead clean, eluting in 25 µL nuclease‑free water and recovering 24 µL.

steps.title: Library QC or pooling
steps.instruction: Proceed to quality‑check the finished libraries and/or perform equal‑volume pooling to assess representation before downstream sequencing.

steps.title: Dispense USER/PCR master mix to new plate
steps.instruction: Load a new sterile empty 384‑well PCR plate into the Echo destination port and, using the GP setting, dispense 10 900 nL of USER/PCR master mix into each well.
